notes.title: BBM Dev: Building a Battlefield
notes.notes:
[p]Hey folks,

Here's a video of how we built our first battlefield for Blades, Bows & Magic - A casual, medieval fantasy, strategy card battler.

We're using a mix of 2D for the cards, fx and ui, with 3D for the environments using the fantastic pixel shader - ProPixelizer - by ElliotB256 on the unity asset store.

Check it out!

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivib9Ctic-Y"][/dynamiclink][/p]
